name: Woolman-Groet-Miller Endowment Fund grants
summary: Standing grant fund of a local Audubon chapter for specific conservation and environmental education projects such as plantings and prairie seeding, with priority for St. Joseph and Elkhart Counties in Indiana.

steps: Online application or printed application by mail

eligibility.rule: Be a school or government agency, or a 501(c)3 with an environmental, education or conservation mission
Not be an individual or for-profit business
Request support for a specific project or expenditure
Not request support for operating expenses or an endowment

applicant_types.quote: Organizations eligible to receive grants from the WGM Fund include schools, government agencies such as state and county parks, and 501(c)3 (not-for-profit) organizations whose missions are environment-, education- or conservation-oriented.

access.quote: The Society is interested in learning of worthwhile environmental and conservation programs and invites proposals from the community.

effort.quote: If you would like to apply for a WGM Grant, please fill out our online application. Alternatively, if you prefer to print a copy of the application, you may mail it to:

eligibility.quote: Organizations eligible to receive grants from the WGM Fund include schools, government agencies such as state and county parks, and 501(c)3 (not-for-profit) organizations whose missions are environment-, education- or conservation-oriented.
Disbursements will not be made to individuals or to for-profit businesses.
Proposals must be for specific projects or expenditures, explicitly described.
Requests for support of an organization's operating ex-penses or endowment will not be considered.
